agentic.message: What is the maximum number of students in one block?
agentic.answer:
Source excerpts (no model-generated answer):

• Students enroll in EduSuite and are blocked into sections first come, first served: a block holds up to 35 students; when full, a new block opens. [1]
• Students see published learning materials and assessments for their block's courses; they open materials and answer assessments in the system (or receive them physically, outside the system). [2]

agentic.message: Who gets priority when a course is assigned to an instructor?
agentic.answer: When a course is assigned to an instructor, priority 1 holders of master's degrees get the course first, followed by those with specializations or forté in the course [1]. The AI role provides two modes: assist mode where the admin manually assigns courses and auto mode where the AI proposes assignments based on the priority rule before confirming them with the Dean/Assoc Dean for final approval [1].

agentic.message: What are the levels of the revised cognitive domain from 2001?
agentic.answer: The levels of the revised cognitive domain from 2001 are Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate, and Create [1].

agentic.message: If a loop checks its condition at the end, how often does the body run at minimum?
agentic.answer: If a loop checks its condition at the end, the minimum number of times the body runs is once [1]. This occurs when the loop's termination condition is met before any iterations are skipped due to the incrementing or decrementing of the loop variable [1]. The exact number of executions can vary depending on factors such as rounding errors and hardware constraints, but it will always be at least one time [1].

agentic.message: Which kind of tree is designed to retrieve strings efficiently?
agentic.answer: The kind of tree designed to retrieve strings efficiently is called a trie (also known as a prefix tree) [1].

agentic.message: What happens to an extracted field whose confidence is under 60 percent?
agentic.answer: An extracted field whose confidence score is below 60% will be flagged and excluded from "ready to submit" counts according to the EduPulse syllabus ingestion specification (FORM-BE-10) [1]. The instructor must explicitly accept or overwrite it using the Accept/Reject control [2].

agentic.message: Summarize what the flow specification says about syllabus approval.
agentic.answer:
1. The approval loop for a syllabus involves three steps: Dean review → CAO approval → EVP noting [1].
2. AI assists in co-writing sections of the syllabus or generates an entire syllabus as an auto output, which is saved with status `drafted` [1].
3. A syllabus must be approved by the Dean, CAO, and EVP before it can be uploaded for use [1].
4. The Dean reviews the approved syllabus to ensure it meets course requirements and aligns with departmental standards [2].
5. Instructors view a scoring sheet that collates all assessment scores per student per course [2].
6. Notifications are sent regarding unopened materials, unanswered assessments, and missing assignments.
